questions.stem: A biased coin lands heads 30% of the time. How many heads would you expect in 200 tosses?
How many different sequences of heads and tails are possible in 5 tosses?
questions.explain: Each toss has 2 results and the choices multiply: 2⁵ = 32.

questions.stem: X takes the values 0, 1 and 2 with probabilities 0.4, 0.4 and 0.2. What is the expected value of X?
questions.explain: Weight each value by its probability: 0 × 0.4 + 1 × 0.4 + 2 × 0.2 = 0.8.

questions.stem: In 5 trials, in how many ways can exactly 2 of the trials be successes?
questions.explain: Choose the 2 successful trials out of 5: C(5, 2) = 10.
